record.question: Choose the correct verb in agreement with the subject: __________ of the two girls is tall.
record.explanation: Answer B: Neither. “Neither of the two girls” means not one of the pair and is compatible with singular “is”. “Nil” is a quantity, and the standard paired construction uses neither rather than none. Original paper prints three choices; the empty imported fourth slot was removed after visual source inspection. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no examiner key is asserted.
